message.content:
This document describes **Project Maya**, a local LLM inference stack for running large MoE models on consumer/prosumer hardware. Key technical points:

**Quantization & Models**
- Maya quants are named by model + tier (XS/S/M/L) based on expert bit-width, avoiding name collisions.
- GLM-5.3-Flash quants (Maya-S/S24/M/M-Derisked/L) range 94.7–156.3 GB, retaining the MTP drafting block; accuracy vs. FP8 original is 97.7–99.2%, with 83–90% next
